effective_plan.transformation: Keep round60 source-closed point fusion for expressions which actually remove a floating classification: count source F64 MatrixCellAccess/arithmetic outputs (not copies) versus distinct escaping F64 outputs. Decline a prefix when no classification disappears, leaving its original native scalar reads/control. Separately lower the shared ordered-dot core with carried stream addresses and two consecutive ordered terms per loop trip, followed by one guarded odd term. Remove per-term index*stride reconstruction and halve loop-control trips while preserving every output accumulator, original +0, exact k order and separate rounded multiply/add. No extra term is loaded when count is0/odd. Source immutable stream bounds/loans and all failure/replay paths remain.

source_audit.new_loop: Shared Cranelift ordered-dot core carries each admitted stream address. Loop admission requires remaining>=2 before either of two complete ordered terms; one guarded final term handles odd counts. Each output starts+0 and consumes k then k+1 through separate rounded multiply/add, with no partial sums, reassociation or FMA. Modular one-past address computations are never dereferenced. Empty/null, zero/nonunit/negative strides, odd/even extents, independent scalar/SIMD lanes and cancellation-sensitive exact results are tested. Genuine four-row paired loop has8 multiply/8 add instructions and no integer stride product in its loop body.
source_audit.profitability: A prefix must eliminate at least one floating classification per escaping word: count actual F64 source reads/arithmetic results excluding copies, compare with escaping F64 outputs, decline when fewer classifications disappear than escaping floating words. The ordinary native scalar path then retains source checks. The source rule uses no benchmark identity, dimensions or data assumptions. Genuine Seidel code and stack exactly match round60; Nussinov raw-load-only regions disappear.
source_audit.closure: Source-private NativeMatchValue identities retain exact definition/read-role queries. Every prefix is bounded single-entry straight-line same-iteration source, with unique scalar definitions and a complete inventory of external scalar observers. Only total pure F64 add/sub/mul/div/neg/sqrt, checked U64 add/sub/mul, scalar copies and selected F64 MatrixCellAccess recipes are admitted. No store, owner-copy, opaque library call, conversion, unsupported control or source/phase/debit boundary is crossed. The existing read-pack boundary inventory is shared. No ordinal is promoted to a source witness.
source_audit.admission: Pure checked U64 intermediates are reconstructed with exact add/sub/mul overflow tests. Repeated identical current expressions reuse compiler SSA values. Each distinct current one-based row/column is checked against its exact already validated bank geometry; one combined admission branch precedes every speculative source load. Entry owner/epoch/span/capacity/schema admission remains the original numeric loan. There are no global readonly/alias/alignment claims or facts crossing a state update.
source_audit.arithmetic: Source scalar F64 loads/arithmetic retain original operand tree, term order and rounding using the shared native F64 emitter. No reassociation/FMA/reciprocal substitution/SIMD of dependent outputs. Admitted operators propagate used NaNs. Aggregate all escaping F64 final-result nonfinite masks and decline before any raw-word export; the exact original source prefix then runs at the same current state, preserving nonfinite payloads and first source failures. Intermediate Infinity with a finite final result keeps exact strict bits.
source_audit.state_and_errors: Successful prefix evaluation exports only source-observed scalar results into the existing word bank, then rejoins unchanged lexical write/first-change/COW/no-op machinery. A declined prefix has made no scalar export, mutation or publication and replays only this lexical prefix; prior in-place updates remain current and cannot be rewound. Existing current view reloads, source aliases, no-op copy behavior, finite denial, atomic previous external outputs and cleanup/retry remain.
source_audit.accounting: Original source fee/debit/control obligations remain. No owner/helper/frame/ABI/cache/mode/per-operation allocation additions and no source step/visit/bill reductions or counter padding. All optimization execution counters must exactly match accepted59 in the untimed gate and every single probe observation.
